visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An elderly Asian male chef wearing a light blue medical mask and a white polo shirt with green and yellow accents stands behind a wooden counter. He carefully holds a tall glass filled with a creamy yellow smoothie garnished with a lime slice and red berries. (2) The camera cuts to the entrance of a restaurant featuring a red noren curtain with large white Japanese kanji characters. The background shows a brightly lit indoor space with brick-style wallpaper and several framed pictures on the wall. (3) Close-up shots on a metal griddle show a chef using metal spatulas to stir-fry a large portion of yellow noodles. A mixture of batter and cabbage is spread on the grill, topped with the noodles and raw slices of fatty pork. (4) A cooked Okonomiyaki is topped with a generous amount of dark brown sauce, swirls of creamy white mayonnaise, a dusting of green seaweed powder, and a heap of thin, pinkish-brown bonito flakes that appear to move slightly. (5) Various other dishes are presented on a table, including a plate of stir-fried noodles with green vegetables and meat, and a plate of golden-brown fried chicken nuggets served with a side of fresh cabbage salad and cherry tomatoes. (6) A final close-up of a tall smoothie glass shows the vibrant yellow liquid, topped with a fresh lime wedge and small red fruit pieces. The scene shifts to showing a hand pouring amber-colored tea from a black plastic tap into a small cup.
